short_description.1: person: Humans of all ages, in various poses (standing, sitting, running), clothing, and contexts, from close-up faces to full-body shots in diverse environments.
short_description.2: bicycle: Two-wheeled vehicles ranging from mountain and road bikes to cruisers, shown from multiple angles, often with riders, and in various states (parked, moving).
short_description.3: car: Sedans, SUVs, hatchbacks, and sports cars in multiple colors, shown from front/side/rear views, in motion or parked on streets, highways, or parking lots.
short_description.4: motorcycle: Two-wheeled motor vehicles including sport bikes, cruisers, and scooters, with riders or alone, shown from various angles on roads or stationary.
short_description.5: airplane: Commercial jets, prop planes, and smaller aircraft in flight against skies, on runways, or taxiing, with visible wings, fuselage, and tail sections.
short_description.6: bus: Large passenger vehicles including city transit buses, school buses, and coaches, shown in urban settings, at stops, or in traffic, from side/front perspectives.
short_description.7: train: Multi-car rail vehicles including commuter trains, locomotives with freight cars, and high-speed trains on tracks in stations, crossings, or open landscapes.
short_description.8: truck: Large vehicles ranging from pickup trucks to semi-trailer trucks and box trucks, carrying cargo or empty, on highways, construction sites, or parked.
short_description.9: boat: Water vessels including sailboats, motorboats, kayaks, and large ships on oceans, lakes, or rivers, shown from water-level or aerial views.
short_description.10: traffic light: Signal fixtures with red/yellow/green lenses, mounted on poles or street wires, shown alone or in street scenes, both operational and inactive.
short_description.11: fire hydrant: Vertical metal posts typically red, yellow, or silver with multiple nozzle ports, found curbside in urban settings, often partially visible or occluded.
short_description.12: street sign: Rectangular or square metal signs mounted on poles with text/symbols for directions or regulations, shown in urban environments at various heights.
short_description.13: stop sign: Red octagonal traffic signs with white borders and 'STOP' lettering, mounted on poles at intersections, shown from various angles and distances.
short_description.14: parking meter: Street-side payment devices of varying heights with coin slots and digital displays, often silver or black, positioned near curbs in parking areas.
short_description.15: bench: Long public seating made of wood, metal, or concrete slats, found in parks, bus stops, and sidewalks, empty or occupied, in various conditions.
short_description.16: bird: Various species from sparrows to seagulls shown perched, in flight, or on ground, with diverse plumage colors and sizes, in natural or urban environments.
short_description.17: cat: Domestic felines of different breeds and colors (tabby, black, white) in various poses - sitting, sleeping, walking - both indoors and outdoors.
short_description.18: dog: Multiple breeds from small terriers to large retrievers in various colors and coat types, shown sitting, running, or playing in diverse settings.
short_description.19: horse: Large equines including thoroughbreds, ponies, and work horses in pastures, arenas, or with riders, shown grazing, running, or standing.
short_description.20: sheep: Woolly farm animals typically white with occasional black markings, shown in fields grazing, standing, or in herds, often with lambs in spring.
short_description.21: cow: Domestic cattle, typically black, white, or brown, often seen grazing in pastures or standing in farm settings, with full body or close-up views.
short_description.22: elephant: Massive gray mammals with trunks and tusks, shown in savannas or zoos, from full body profiles to close-ups of heads and tusks.
short_description.23: bear: Large omnivores including brown, black, and polar bears in forests, mountains, or Arctic settings, standing, walking, or climbing.
short_description.24: zebra: African equines with distinctive black and white stripes, typically shown in herds on savannas, grazing or running.
short_description.25: giraffe: Extremely tall animals with long necks and spotted patterns, shown browsing treetops on savannas or in zoo enclosures.
short_description.26: hat: Headwear including baseball caps, beanies, and sun hats in various materials and colors, worn by people or placed on surfaces.
short_description.27: backpack: Bag worn on back with two straps, ranging from school bags to hiking packs, carried by people or placed on surfaces.
short_description.28: umbrella: Canopy devices for rain or sun protection in various colors, open or closed, held by people or leaning against objects.
short_description.29: shoe: Footwear ranging from sneakers and dress shoes to boots, shown in pairs or singles, being worn, on floors, or in retail settings.
short_description.30: eye glasses: Vision aids with frames and lenses, including sunglasses and prescription types, worn on faces, held in hands, or resting on surfaces.
short_description.31: handbag: Carried bags including purses, clutches, and totes in diverse materials and colors, held in hand or over shoulder.
short_description.32: tie: Neckwear of varying patterns (striped, solid, patterned) worn with formal shirts, shown knotted or loosely hanging.
short_description.33: suitcase: Rectangular travel luggage with handles and wheels, hard or soft-shell, being carried, rolled, or stacked in travel settings.
short_description.34: frisbee: Flying disc toys in various bright colors, shown in mid-air during throws, caught in hands, or on the ground in parks and recreational areas.
short_description.35: skis: Long narrow snow sports equipment in pairs, shown being worn by people on slopes, carried over shoulder, or leaning against objects.
short_description.36: snowboard: Single wide board for snow riding, shown with riders on mountain slopes, carried horizontally, or resting in snow.
short_description.37: sports ball: Various types including soccer balls, basketballs, and volleyballs in different sizes and patterns, shown in play, held, or on surfaces.
short_description.38: kite: Lightweight flying objects with strings, in diamond, delta, or animal shapes, shown airborne in skies or held by people on beaches and fields.
short_description.39: baseball bat: Long cylindrical wooden or metal clubs, shown being swung, held ready, or leaning against equipment in baseball settings.
short_description.40: baseball glove: Leather mitts with webbing, typically brown, worn on hand or resting on surfaces, often paired with bats in baseball contexts.
short_description.41: skateboard: Short deck with four wheels, shown being ridden in skate parks or streets, carried under arm, or resting on ground.
short_description.42: surfboard: Long buoyant boards for riding waves, ranging from shortboards to longboards, shown being carried, ridden on waves, or resting on beaches.
short_description.43: tennis racket: Oval-headed strung equipment with handles, shown being swung, held in hand, or resting on courts, often with tennis balls.
short_description.44: bottle: Tall containers of various shapes and colors (glass/plastic) for liquids, shown upright, held, or on tables, both full and empty.
short_description.45: plate: Flat dishware in round or oval shapes, ceramic or plastic, shown empty or with food, on tables in dining settings.
short_description.46: wine glass: Stemmed glassware with bowl-shaped tops, clear or containing liquid, shown on tables in dining settings or being held.
short_description.47: cup: Cylindrical drinking vessels including mugs and tumblers, with handles or without, containing beverages or empty on surfaces.
short_description.48: fork: Utensils with multiple tines and handles, metal or plastic, shown on tables, in place settings, or being held during meals.
short_description.49: knife: Bladed utensils of various sizes, from dinner knives to chef knives, shown on cutting boards, tables, or in use with food.
short_description.50: spoon: Bowled utensils with handles, shown in place settings, stirring drinks, or being used for eating various foods.
short_description.51: bowl: Round deep dishes of various sizes and materials, containing food like cereal or soup, or empty on tables and counters.
short_description.52: banana: Curved yellow fruit sometimes shown in bunches, peeled or unpeeled, with green or brown variations, held in hand or on surfaces.
short_description.53: apple: Round fruits in red, green, or yellow varieties, shown whole, bitten, or sliced, often with visible stems and in baskets or on tables.
short_description.54: sandwich: Layered food between bread slices with visible fillings like lettuce, meat, or cheese, shown whole, halved, or being eaten.
short_description.55: orange: Round citrus fruits with textured peel, shown whole, peeled with segments, or as slices, often in bowls or fruit arrangements.
short_description.56: broccoli: Green vegetable with tree-like florets and thick stalks, shown raw in bunches, cooked on plates, or as part of meals.
short_description.57: carrot: Elongated orange root vegetables with green tops, shown whole, chopped, cooked, or being held, often in kitchen settings.
short_description.58: hot dog: Cooked sausage in sliced bun, often with visible condiments like ketchup or mustard, held in hand or on plates at events.
short_description.59: pizza: Round flatbread with tomato sauce, cheese, and various toppings, shown as whole pies, slices, or in boxes, often in dining contexts.
short_description.60: donut: Ring-shaped or filled pastries with glazes, sprinkles, or powdered sugar, shown in boxes, on plates, or being eaten.
short_description.61: cake: Baked desserts in layered, sheet, or cupcake form with frosting and decorations, shown whole, sliced, or at celebrations.
short_description.62: chair: Various seating furniture including dining chairs, office chairs, and armchairs in multiple materials and colors, shown occupied or empty in indoor and outdoor settings.
short_description.63: couch: Upholstered multi-person seating like sofas and loveseats in various styles and fabrics, often with pillows, in living rooms or lounges.
short_description.64: potted plant: Plants contained in pots of different sizes and materials, ranging from small succulents to large foliage, placed indoors on surfaces or outdoors in gardens.
short_description.65: bed: Sleeping furniture with mattresses and frames, including single, double, or bunk beds, made of wood or metal, often with bedding in bedroom settings.
short_description.66: mirror: Reflective surfaces in wall-mounted, handheld, or standing formats, showing reflections of people/objects or the surrounding environment.
short_description.67: dining table: Tables designed for meals in rectangular, round, or oval shapes, made of wood, glass, or other materials, with or without place settings in dining areas.
short_description.68: window: Glass panes in building walls with frames, showing interior reflections or exterior views, often with curtains or blinds partially drawn.
short_description.69: desk: Work surfaces with legs, including office and writing desks, made of wood or metal, often with computers or paperwork in study/office settings.
short_description.70: toilet: Bathroom fixtures with bowl, seat, and tank, typically white porcelain, shown in bathroom settings, clean or in use.
short_description.71: door: Entryways with handles/knobs in wood, glass, or metal materials, shown open, closed, or with people passing through in architectural contexts.
short_description.72: tv: Television sets ranging from flat-screens to older models, mounted on walls or on stands, with screens showing content or turned off in living rooms.
short_description.73: laptop: Portable computing devices with hinged screens and keyboards, shown open in use on desks or laps, or closed and carried, in various colors and sizes.
short_description.74: mouse: Computer input devices, both wired and wireless, with left/right buttons and scroll wheel, shown on desks or being held by hands.
short_description.75: remote: Handheld electronic controllers for TVs and devices with multiple buttons, shown on tables, sofas, or held in hands.
short_description.76: keyboard: Computer input devices with QWERTY key layouts, both mechanical and membrane types, shown on desks or with hands typing.
short_description.77: cell phone: Mobile devices including smartphones and older models, held in hands for use, placed on surfaces, or showing screens with content.
short_description.78: microwave: Countertop appliances with glass doors and control panels, shown in kitchens with doors open or closed, often with food inside.
short_description.79: oven: Large cooking appliances including built-in and standalone models with doors and control knobs, shown in kitchens with interior visible or closed.
short_description.80: toaster: Countertop appliances with slots for bread, in various sizes and colors, shown on kitchen counters with or without visible toast.
short_description.81: sink: Plumbing fixtures including kitchen and bathroom types with faucets, made of stainless steel or ceramic, empty or with running water.
short_description.82: refrigerator: Large cooling appliances with single or double doors and handles, shown in kitchens with doors open revealing contents or closed.
short_description.83: blender: Electric kitchen appliances with pitcher bases and blade assemblies, shown on countertops, in use, or with visible liquid contents.
short_description.84: book: Bound pages with covers, shown closed on shelves, open for reading, or held in hands, with various sizes and cover designs.
short_description.85: clock: Time-telling devices including wall clocks, alarm clocks, and digital displays, showing various times in indoor and outdoor settings.
short_description.86: vase: Containers of various shapes, sizes, and materials (ceramic, glass) holding flowers, empty, or as decorative pieces on tables and shelves.
short_description.87: scissors: Cutting tools with two blades and handles, shown open or closed, in use for cutting paper/fabric or resting on surfaces.
short_description.88: teddy bear: Stuffed toy bears with plush fabric in various colors and sizes, shown held by people, sitting on beds, or in toy collections.
short_description.89: hair drier: Handheld electric devices with handles and nozzles, shown in use drying hair, or resting on bathroom counters with cords.
short_description.90: toothbrush: Small oral hygiene tools with handles and bristles, shown in bathrooms being used, in holders, or with toothpaste applied.
